description: This file contains unit tests for CancellationToken functionality within the Orleans framework, specifically testing propagation and handling of cancellation across grains and silos, with various configurations for acknowledgement waiting.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests_WaitForAcknowledgement
classes.description: Test class for cancellation token behavior with acknowledgement waiting enabled.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests_NoWaitForAcknowledgement
classes.description: Test class for cancellation token behavior with acknowledgement waiting disabled.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests
classes.description: Base class containing various tests for cancellation token propagation, cancellation handling, and associated callback behaviors in Orleans grains and silos.

methods.name: GrainTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation of a long-running grain task with different delays.

methods.name: MultipleGrainsTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation of multiple grains' tasks simultaneously.

methods.name: GrainTaskMultipleCancellations
methods.description: Tests multiple cancellation calls on a single grain task.

methods.name: TokenPassingWithoutCancellation_NoExceptionShouldBeThrown
methods.description: Verifies that passing a non-cancelled token does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: PreCancelledTokenPassing
methods.description: Ensures that a pre-cancelled token causes the grain task to throw an OperationCanceledException.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksExecutionContext
methods.description: Validates the execution context of cancellation callbacks.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksTaskSchedulerContext
methods.description: Checks cancellation callbacks execute with the correct task scheduler context.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksThrow_ExceptionDoesNotPropagate
methods.description: Ensures exceptions thrown within cancellation callbacks do not propagate.

methods.name: InSiloCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation within the same silo.

methods.name: InterSiloClientCancellationTokenPassing
methods.description: Tests cancellation token passing from client to silo across silos.

methods.name: InSiloClientCancellationTokenPassing
methods.description: Tests cancellation token passing within the same silo.

methods.name: GetGrains
methods.description: Helper method to obtain two grains possibly placed on different silos for testing.

methods.name: WaitForCallCancellation
methods.description: Helper method to wait until a specific call ID is marked as cancelled.

methods.name: WaitForCallCancellation
methods.description: Overloaded helper to wait for multiple call IDs to be cancelled.
